title: Mass Spectrometry and Computer Simulation Predict the Interactions of AGPS and HNRNPK in Glioma.
authors: Zhou, Wei; Liu, Ying; Li, Honglian; Song, Zhaoyu; Ma, Ying; Zhu, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过质谱和计算机模拟预测AGPS与HNRNPK蛋白-蛋白相互作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ether lipids are overexpressed in malignant tumor and play an important role in tumor process. Glioma is the most common malignant central nervous system tumor, and the content of ether lipids is higher than that of normal tissues. Alkylglycerone phosphate synthase (AGPS) is a key enzyme in the synthesis of ether esters and plays a vital role in maintaining the morphology and pathogenic properties of tumor cells. The cell proliferation and the content of tumor-related lipid such as monoalkylglycerol ether (MAGe), lysophosphatidic acid ether (LPAe), lysophosphatidylcholine ether (LPCe), lysophosphatidylethanolamine ether (LPEe), phosphatidyl inositol (PI), phosphatidylcholine (PC), and phosphatidylserine (PS) were suppressed after AGPS silencing in U251, H4, and TJ905 cells; however, heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein K (HNRNPK) could reverse the above phenomenon such as cellar proliferation and ether lipid secretion. We found that HNRNPK was the target protein of AGPS by coimmunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry assay and verified by western blot assay in U251 cells. It confirmed that AGPS and HNRNPK are coexpressed in the cellular nucleus by a confocal laser microscope. The main protein-protein interaction mechanism between AGPS and HNRNPK is hydrogen bond, conjugation bond, hydrophobic bond, and electrostatic force by computer simulation prediction.
abstract_zh: 醚脂在恶性肿瘤中过表达，并在肿瘤进程中发挥重要作用。胶质瘤是最常见的恶性中枢神经系统肿瘤，其醚脂含量高于正常组织。烷基甘油酮磷酸合酶（AGPS）是醚酯合成中的关键酶，在维持肿瘤细胞形态和致病特性中起至关重要作用。在U251、H4和TJ905细胞中沉默AGPS后，细胞增殖及肿瘤相关脂质如单烷基甘油醚（MAGe）、溶血磷脂酸醚（LPAe）、溶血磷脂酰胆碱醚（LPCe）、溶血磷脂酰乙醇胺醚（LPEe）、磷脂酰肌醇（PI）、磷脂酰胆碱（PC）和磷脂酰丝氨酸（PS）的含量受到抑制；然而，异质核核糖核蛋白K（HNRNPK）可逆转上述现象，如细胞增殖和醚脂分泌。通过免疫共沉淀和质谱分析，我们发现HNRNPK是AGPS的靶蛋白，并在U251细胞中通过蛋白质印迹实验验证。共聚焦激光显微镜证实AGPS和HNRNPK在细胞核中共表达。计算机模拟预测表明，AGPS与HNRNPK之间的主要蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用机制包括氢键、共轭键、疏水键和静电力。
